versions.changelog: Supports Linux, macOS, and native Windows. Adds Windows npm shim and roaming-prefix discovery, enables the macOS downloader, rejects nonportable archive paths, and verifies real-package installation, updates, and rollback on all three operating systems.
Separates fenced code from prose with a 20-24 px scale and 1.4 line spacing so receipt and block-art rows no longer overlap.
Expand the transcript and composer across the browser width; replace installer subprocess calls with validated Node.js discovery and path-safe archive extraction.
